title: Rooms to reserve
prompt: What rooms did the speaker ask to reserve?
hint: Say 'Please reserve' and then list the two room types.
sample: Please reserve one double and one twin.

ja.prompt: 話者はどのタイプの部屋を予約するよう頼みましたか？
ja.hint: 「Please reserve」で始めて、2つの部屋の種類を言ってください。
ja.sample: ダブル1室とツイン1室をお願いします。

local.prompt: 讲话者要求预订哪些房间？
local.hint: 以“Please reserve”开头，然后列出两个房型。
local.sample: 请预订一间双人房和一间双床房。

local_pron.prompt: jiǎnghuà zhě yāoqiú yùdìng nǎxiē fángjiān?
local_pron.hint: yǐ 'Please reserve' kāitóu, ránhòu lièchū liǎng gè fángxíng.
local_pron.sample: qǐng yùdìng yī jiān shuāngrén fáng hé yī jiān shuāngchuáng fáng.

en.sample: Please reserve one double and one twin.

title: Length of reservation
prompt: How long is the reservation under the name Stuart?
hint: Start with 'It is for' then say 'seven nights with breakfast included'.
sample: It is for seven nights with breakfast included.

ja.hint: 「It is for」で始めて、「seven nights with breakfast included」と言ってください。

local.prompt: 以Stuart姓名的预订是多长时间？
local.hint: 以'It is for'开头，然后说'seven nights with breakfast included'。

local_pron.prompt: yǐ Stuart xìngmíng de yùdìng shì duō cháng shíjiān?
local_pron.hint: yǐ 'It is for' kāitóu, ránhòu shuō 'seven nights with breakfast included'.
local_pron.sample: zhè shì wéi qī qī wǎn, hán zǎocān.
